messages.subject: Deducer suddenly crashing????
messages.body_plain:
Hi Ian et al.,

For some inexplicable reason Deducer now fails at start up.
I loads the JGR console and Data viewer then an error message pops up:

javaw.exe has encountered a problem and needs to close.

Then JGR and Deducer shut down

Error details as Ii can see AppName :javaw.exe  AppVer 6.0.210.7 ModName
java.dll

I just DL the full Deducer install again but same thing.

However when I launch JGR-Deducer and this error box pops up I
discovered if I ignore the send report (leave it open) it seems that
Deducer works fine???
How does one disable the MS error message program?

I also reinstalled the latest version of JAVA

Still Puzzled

Bruce
